guard: cotal login caches the account name the IdP gave beside the session, and the provider's userStatus returns it with the login, so a chat session can appear under it
why: A chat session in user mode appears under the name the IdP gave at login. Each mutation drops that name at one of the two places it travels: the login that caches it, and the offline status read that returns it. The suite imports @cotal-ai/auth from src, so no build is needed.

mutations.name: establishIdpSession does not save the name
mutations.expectRed: login records the account name the IdP gave (its email) beside the session
mutations.cell: login records the account name the IdP gave (its email) beside the session

mutations.name: userStatus drops the recorded name
mutations.find: const login = { sub: session.sub, expiresAt: session.expiresAt, ...(session.name ? { name: session.name } : {}) };
mutations.replace: const login = { sub: session.sub, expiresAt: session.expiresAt };
mutations.expectRed: userStatus returns the recorded account name with the login
mutations.cell: userStatus returns the recorded account name with the login
